┌─ Help: Quest chains and fighting ────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Quest chains                                                                 │
│   Ctrl+K            the quest chain screen (or /quest); X there gives it up  │
│                     for good, after one question                             │
│                                                                              │
│   A new character is offered First Steps in Thornwick: talk to the Watch     │
│   greeter in Hawthorn Square, talk to your class trainer, take a contract    │
│   from the board, then go out through the east gate. It pays a small reward  │
│   at the end.                                                                │
│   It is optional. Nothing walks you anywhere and nothing reminds you; the    │
│   Quest chain panel shows the step you are on, and the log tells you when    │
│   one is done. A dismissed chain is never offered again.                     │
│                                                                              │
│ Fighting                                                                     │
│   Tab               choose the next target                                   │
│   Esc               clear the target                                         │
│   F, Space          auto-attack on or off                                    │
│   Ctrl+R            auto-retaliate on or off (on, you fight back when        │
│                     attacked, even with no input)                            │
│   1-8               use the ability in that slot on your target              │
│ Page 4 of 9  Up, Down scroll  ? next page  Left, Right turn  Esc closes      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
